verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents simultaneous multi-user editing, live cursors, or real-time sync in Framer. The only collaboration-page item covers Branches, which is a separate copy-and-merge workflow rather than live multiplayer editing. Real-time collaboration is a fair axis for a visual design tool, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync
